visualCharacteristics.purpose: Newsroom search results page with search band, type tabs, tag filter and result rows
visualCharacteristics.layout: Gradient search band above tabs, scrollable tag filter, result count and bordered result rows with 16:9 thumbnails
notable: Client-side search and tag filter over the authored results
Bold list item marks the active type tab

contentPattern.structure: Rows classified by content: an h1 title row, a type tab list, a tag filter list, a result count paragraph, result rows (meta and date paragraphs, linked heading, teaser, picture), a load-more label and empty/error heading rows
contentPattern.rows: Header rows, one row per result, trailing state rows

usage: Use for a newsroom listing page with searchable, filterable news results
reuseGuidance: Fits lists of news items with meta, date, linked title, teaser and thumbnail; not for small teaser grids or non-news content
